description: A PWM generator. Module `pwm` with inputs clk, rst_n (active-low reset) and duty (8 bits), and output out. An 8-bit counter is 0 during reset and goes up by one at every rising clock edge, wrapping from 255 to 0. out is 1 while the counter is below duty, so duty 0 is always off and duty 255 is on for 255 of every 256 cycles. out follows a change of duty straight away (no extra register).

starter.title: PWM output
starter.summary: Dims an LED or drives a motor: an 8-bit duty value sets how long the output is on in every 256 cycles.
